verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਰੇ ਪਰਬਤਾਂ ਅਸਮਾਨ ਖਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: naa tis bhaare parabataa(n) asamaan khaha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The sky-touching mountains also are not of much weight (than the ungrateful person).

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਰੇ ਕੋਟ ਗੜ੍ਹ ਘਰਬਾਰ ਦਿਸੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: naa tis bhaare koT gaRh gharabaar dhisa(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The visible forts are also not as weighty as he (the ungrateful person) is;

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਰੇ ਸਾਇਰਾਂ ਨਦ ਵਾਹ ਵਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: naa tis bhaare sairaa(n) nadh vaeh vaha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Those oceans in which will the rivers merge are also not as heavy as he is;

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਰੇ ਤਰੁਵਰਾਂ ਫਲ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: naa tis bhaare taruvaraa(n) fal sufal fala(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The fruit laden trees are also not as heavy as he is

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਰੇ ਜੀਅਜੰਤ ਅਣਗਣਤ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: naa tis bhaare jeeaja(n)t anaganat fira(n)dhe|

en.bdb: And nor those innumerable creatures are as heavy as he is.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਰੇ ਭੁਈਂ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣ ਮੰਦੀ ਹੂ ਮੰਦੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit_en: bhaare bhuiee(n) akirataghan ma(n)dhee hoo ma(n)dhe ||8||

en.bdb: In fact the ungrateful person is burden on earth and he is evil of evils.
